characters.name: Mara Vale
characters.appearance: Fictional woman with warm brown skin, short wavy black hair, amber eyes, a narrow scar through her left eyebrow, and a poised, observant expression.

characters.name: Elior Reed
characters.appearance: Fictional man with deep umber skin, close-cropped dark hair, gray-green eyes, a square jaw, and a calm expression softened by a small dimple on his right cheek.

characters.name: Penn Orin
characters.appearance: Fictional young adult with copper-brown skin, long dark braid, hazel eyes, round spectacles, and an alert, wry expression.

locations.description: A quiet glasshouse studio with tall rain-streaked windows, pale worktables, hanging plants, and late-afternoon light falling across a worn wooden floor.
A windy harbor overlook above slate-blue water, with weathered railings, distant cranes, gulls, and a low sun breaking through layered clouds.

outfits.description: A charcoal field coat over an ivory knit shirt, dark trousers, sturdy brown boots, and a narrow copper watch.
A moss-green wool sweater over a pale blue shirt, rolled charcoal trousers, polished black shoes, and a weathered canvas satchel.

scenes.interaction: Mara braces one hand on the harbor railing while Elior stands close behind her, one arm crossing in front of her to steady her as they lean together against the wind.
